name: Medical Scan Chillers
h1: Medical Scan Chillers for MRI and CT
title: Medical Scan Chiller Manufacturer, Coimbatore | MRI & CT Cooling
description: Process chillers for MRI and CT imaging equipment, engineered to order by Win Equipments, Coimbatore. Share your scanner's cooling requirement for sizing.
card: Chillers engineered to order for the cooling circuits of MRI and CT scanners.
lede: Imaging systems such as MRI and CT scanners reject heat into a closed water circuit that must be held at the temperature the equipment maker specifies. Win Equipments builds chillers for these duties to order, sized from your scanner's cooling requirement.
needs: Scanner make and model, and the OEM's cooling specification
Heat load (kW) and required supply water temperature
Water flow rate and allowable pressure drop
Available power supply and installation space
Whether a standby or backup arrangement is required

faqs.q: Why is there no standard model table?
faqs.a: These units are engineered to order around your duty, so we size and quote each one from your requirement rather than publishing a fixed model list. Send your requirement and our engineers will reply with a recommended configuration.
